The parallel line through \((1,0)\) is
\[
y=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}(x-1) \implies x-\sqrt2 y-1=0.
\]
Distance from center \((6,\sqrt2)\) to this line:
\[
d=\frac{|6-\sqrt2\cdot \sqrt2-1|}{\sqrt{1+2}}
=\frac{|6-2-1|}{\sqrt3}=\sqrt3.
\]
Radius \(r=\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt3\). Chord length:
\[
2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}=2\sqrt{12-3}=2\sqrt9=6.
\]
\[
\boxed{6}
\]
